import Mathlib

inductive Color
| Red
| Black
deriving Inhabited, BEq

inductive Node
| Empty : Node
| Tree  (color : Color) (val : Int) (left : Node) (right : Node) : Node
deriving Inhabited

def view (t : Node) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => ∅
  | Node.Tree _ v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_red (t : Node) : Bool :=
  match t with
  | Node.Tree Color.Red _ _ _ => true
  | _ => false

def is_bst (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => True
  | Node.Tree _ v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

-- Black Height: Returns -1 if invalid
def black_height (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => 1
  | Node.Tree c _ l r =>
    let lh := black_height l
    let rh := black_height r
    if lh ≠ -1 ∧ rh ≠ -1 ∧ lh = rh then
      if c == Color.Black then lh + 1 else lh
    else
      -1

def satisfies_red_props (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | Node.Empty => True
  | Node.Tree c _ l r =>
    satisfies_red_props l ∧
    satisfies_red_props r ∧
    -- Rule 1: No Right-Leaning Red (Matches Dafny)
    (if is_red r then False else True) ∧
    -- Rule 2: No Double Red on Left (Matches Dafny)
    -- Check: If Left is Red, then Left.Left must NOT be Red.
    -- This applies regardless of 'c' (current color).
    (match l with
     | Node.Tree Color.Red _ ll _ => 
       (match ll with | Node.Tree Color.Red _ _ _ => False | _ => True)
     | _ => True)

-- This definition is tricky because LLRBT insert allows the root to be red temporarily or permanently if it's the root of the whole tree (though usually root is black).
-- However, the recursive step needs a weaker invariant.
-- Dafny spec says: "This allows the root to be Red or Black"
def is_llrbt (t : Node) : Prop :=
  is_bst t ∧
  black_height t ≠ -1 ∧
  -- We need to check red properties. Dafny's satisfies_red_props handles recursive checks.
  -- But wait, Dafny's `satisfies_red_props` seems to strictly forbid right-leaning reds everywhere?
  -- Let's re-read Dafny carefully.
  -- satisfy_red_props:
  --   left_ok && right_ok && right_is_black && no_double_red
  --   Right is black: if right is red -> false.
  --   No double red on left: if left is red, left.left cannot be red? No, `l.is_red` then `l.left` check?
  --   Dafny: `match this.left { case Some(l) => if l.is_red then match l.left { case Some(ll) => !ll.is_red ...`
  --   This means: If I am any node, my right child cannot be red. And if my left child is red, IT'S left child cannot be red (no consecutive reds on left edge).
  --   What about Me being Red and Left being Red? Dafny spec doesn't explicitly ban `this.is_red && this.left.is_red` in `satisfies_red_props` itself?
  --   Ah, `no_double_red` checks `this.left` (l) and `l.left` (ll).
  --   So it prevents `Red -> Red` on the left edge.
  satisfies_red_props t



-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def insert_precond (t : Node) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_llrbt t
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

def blacken : Node → Node
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree _ x l r => Node.Tree Color.Black x l r

def leftChild : Node → Node
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree _ _ l _ => l

def rightChild : Node → Node
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree _ _ _ r => r

def rotateLeft : Node → Node
  | Node.Tree c x a (Node.Tree Color.Red y b d) =>
      Node.Tree c y (Node.Tree Color.Red x a b) d
  | t => t

def rotateRight : Node → Node
  | Node.Tree c y (Node.Tree Color.Red x a b) d =>
      Node.Tree c x a (Node.Tree Color.Red y b d)
  | t => t

def flipColors : Node → Node
  | Node.Tree c x
      (Node.Tree Color.Red y a b)
      (Node.Tree Color.Red z d e) =>
      Node.Tree c x
        (Node.Tree Color.Black y a b)
        (Node.Tree Color.Black z d e)
  | t => t

def fixUp (t : Node) : Node :=
  let t₁ :=
    if is_red (rightChild t) && !is_red (leftChild t) then
      rotateLeft t
    else
      t
  let t₂ :=
    if is_red (leftChild t₁) &&
        is_red (leftChild (leftChild t₁)) then
      rotateRight t₁
    else
      t₁
  if is_red (leftChild t₂) && is_red (rightChild t₂) then
    flipColors t₂
  else
    t₂

def insertAux : Node → Int → Node
  | Node.Empty, v =>
      Node.Tree Color.Red v Node.Empty Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree c x l r, v =>
      if v < x then
        fixUp (Node.Tree c x (insertAux l v) r)
      else if x < v then
        fixUp (Node.Tree c x l (insertAux r v))
      else
        Node.Tree c x l r

def rootSafe : Node → Prop
  | Node.Empty => True
  | Node.Tree Color.Black _ _ _ => True
  | Node.Tree Color.Red _ l r =>
      is_red l = false ∧ is_red r = false

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def insert (t : Node) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : insert_precond t) : Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  blacken (insertAux (blacken t) v)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def insert_postcond (t : Node) (v : Int) (result : Node)
    (_ : insert_precond t) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_llrbt result ∧
  view result = view t ∪ {v}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

private theorem view_blacken (t : Node) :
    view (blacken t) = view t := by
  cases t <;> rfl

private theorem view_rotateLeft (t : Node) :
    view (rotateLeft t) = view t := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => rfl
  | Tree c x l r =>
      cases r with
      | Empty => rfl
      | Tree rc y rl rr =>
          cases rc
          · ext z
            simp only [rotateLeft, view, Set.mem_union,
              Set.mem_singleton_iff]
            aesop
          · rfl

private theorem view_rotateRight (t : Node) :
    view (rotateRight t) = view t := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => rfl
  | Tree c x l r =>
      cases l with
      | Empty => rfl
      | Tree lc y ll lr =>
          cases lc
          · ext z
            simp only [rotateRight, view, Set.mem_union,
              Set.mem_singleton_iff]
            aesop
          · rfl

private theorem view_flipColors (t : Node) :
    view (flipColors t) = view t := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => rfl
  | Tree c x l r =>
      cases l with
      | Empty => rfl
      | Tree lc y ll lr =>
          cases lc with
          | Black => rfl
          | Red =>
              cases r with
              | Empty => rfl
              | Tree rc z rl rr =>
                  cases rc <;> rfl

private theorem view_fixUp (t : Node) :
    view (fixUp t) = view t := by
  unfold fixUp
  dsimp only
  split
  · split
    · split
      · rw [view_flipColors, view_rotateRight, view_rotateLeft]
      · rw [view_rotateRight, view_rotateLeft]
    · split
      · rw [view_flipColors, view_rotateLeft]
      · rw [view_rotateLeft]
  · split
    · split
      · rw [view_flipColors, view_rotateRight]
      · rw [view_rotateRight]
    · split
      · rw [view_flipColors]
      · rfl

private theorem view_insertAux (t : Node) (v : Int) :
    view (insertAux t v) = view t ∪ {v} := by
  induction t with
  | Empty =>
      ext z
      simp [insertAux, view]
  | Tree c x l r ihl ihr =>
      simp only [insertAux]
      split
      · rw [view_fixUp]
        simp only [view, ihl]
        ext z
        simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        aesop
      · split
        · rw [view_fixUp]
          simp only [view, ihr]
          ext z
          simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
          aesop
        · rename_i h₁ h₂
          have hvx : v = x := by omega
          subst v
          ext z
          simp only [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
          aesop

private theorem black_height_children
    (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node)
    (h : black_height (Node.Tree c x l r) ≠ -1) :
    black_height l ≠ -1 ∧
    black_height r ≠ -1 ∧
    black_height l = black_height r := by
  by_contra hn
  apply h
  simp only [black_height]
  rw [if_neg hn]

private theorem black_height_pos (t : Node)
    (h : black_height t ≠ -1) :
    0 < black_height t := by
  induction t with
  | Empty =>
      norm_num [black_height]
  | Tree c x l r ihl ihr =>
      have hc := black_height_children c x l r h
      simp only [black_height]
      rw [if_pos hc]
      have hp := ihl hc.1
      cases c with
      | Red =>
          have heq : (Color.Red == Color.Black) = false := by
            decide
          simp only [heq, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
          exact hp
      | Black =>
          have heq : (Color.Black == Color.Black) = true := by
            decide
          simp only [heq, if_true]
          omega

private theorem blacken_valid (t : Node)
    (h : is_llrbt t) :
    is_llrbt (blacken t) := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => exact h
  | Tree c x l r =>
      rcases h with ⟨hbst, hbh, hred⟩
      have hc := black_height_children c x l r hbh
      refine ⟨hbst, ?_, hred⟩
      simp only [blacken, black_height]
      rw [if_pos hc]
      have heq : (Color.Black == Color.Black) = true := by
        decide
      simp only [heq, if_true]
      have hp := black_height_pos l hc.1
      omega

private theorem blacken_rootSafe (t : Node) :
    rootSafe (blacken t) := by
  cases t <;> trivial

private theorem left_valid
    (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node)
    (h : is_llrbt (Node.Tree c x l r)) :
    is_llrbt l := by
  rcases h with ⟨hb, hh, hr⟩
  simp only [is_bst] at hb
  simp only [satisfies_red_props] at hr
  have hc := black_height_children c x l r hh
  exact ⟨hb.2.1, hc.1, hr.1⟩

private theorem right_valid
    (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node)
    (h : is_llrbt (Node.Tree c x l r)) :
    is_llrbt r := by
  rcases h with ⟨hb, hh, hr⟩
  simp only [is_bst] at hb
  simp only [satisfies_red_props] at hr
  have hc := black_height_children c x l r hh
  exact ⟨hb.2.2.2, hc.2.1, hr.2.1⟩

private theorem left_rootSafe
    (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node)
    (h : satisfies_red_props (Node.Tree c x l r)) :
    rootSafe l := by
  simp only [satisfies_red_props] at h
  rcases h with ⟨hl, hr, hright, hleft⟩
  cases l with
  | Empty => trivial
  | Tree lc y ll lr =>
      cases lc with
      | Black => trivial
      | Red =>
          simp only [rootSafe]
          constructor
          · cases ll with
            | Empty => rfl
            | Tree llc z a b =>
                cases llc with
                | Black => rfl
                | Red =>
                    exact False.elim hleft
          · simp only [satisfies_red_props] at hl
            have hnr := hl.2.2.1
            cases heq : is_red lr with
            | false => exact heq
            | true =>
                simp only [heq, if_true] at hnr

private theorem right_rootSafe
    (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node)
    (h : satisfies_red_props (Node.Tree c x l r)) :
    rootSafe r := by
  simp only [satisfies_red_props] at h
  have hnr := h.2.2.1
  cases r with
  | Empty => trivial
  | Tree rc y rl rr =>
      cases rc with
      | Black => trivial
      | Red =>
          simp only [is_red, if_true] at hnr

private theorem red_leaf_valid (v : Int) :
    is_llrbt (Node.Tree Color.Red v Node.Empty Node.Empty) ∧
    rootSafe (Node.Tree Color.Red v Node.Empty Node.Empty) ∧
    black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red v Node.Empty Node.Empty) =
      black_height Node.Empty := by
  have heq : (Color.Red == Color.Black) = false := by
    decide
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [is_bst, view]
    · simp only [black_height, heq, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
      omega
    · simp [satisfies_red_props, is_red]
  · simp [rootSafe, is_red]
  · simp only [black_height, heq, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]

private theorem fixUp_left_valid
    (c : Color) (x v : Int) (l r : Node)
    (hord : ∀ z ∈ view l ∪ {v}, z < x)
    (hl : is_llrbt (insertAux l v))
    (hls : rootSafe (insertAux l v))
    (hlh : black_height (insertAux l v) = black_height l)
    (hr : is_llrbt r)
    (hroot : rootSafe (Node.Tree c x l r))
    (hparent : is_llrbt (Node.Tree c x l r)) :
    is_llrbt (fixUp (Node.Tree c x (insertAux l v) r)) ∧
    rootSafe (fixUp (Node.Tree c x (insertAux l v) r)) ∧
    black_height (fixUp (Node.Tree c x (insertAux l v) r)) =
      black_height (Node.Tree c x l r) := by
  rcases hl with ⟨hlbst, hlbh, hlred⟩
  rcases hr with ⟨hrbst, hrbh, hrred⟩
  rcases hparent with ⟨hpbst, hpbh, hpred⟩
  simp only [is_bst] at hpbst
  simp only [satisfies_red_props] at hpred
  have hc := black_height_children c x l r hpbh
  unfold fixUp
  dsimp only
  split <;> split <;> split
  <;> simp only [rotateLeft, rotateRight, flipColors,
    leftChild, rightChild, is_red, rootSafe, is_llrbt,
    is_bst, satisfies_red_props, black_height,
    Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at *
  <;> grind

private theorem fixUp_right_valid
    (c : Color) (x v : Int) (l r : Node)
    (hord : ∀ z ∈ view r ∪ {v}, z > x)
    (hl : is_llrbt l)
    (hr : is_llrbt (insertAux r v))
    (hrs : rootSafe (insertAux r v))
    (hrh : black_height (insertAux r v) = black_height r)
    (hroot : rootSafe (Node.Tree c x l r))
    (hparent : is_llrbt (Node.Tree c x l r)) :
    is_llrbt (fixUp (Node.Tree c x l (insertAux r v))) ∧
    rootSafe (fixUp (Node.Tree c x l (insertAux r v))) ∧
    black_height (fixUp (Node.Tree c x l (insertAux r v))) =
      black_height (Node.Tree c x l r) := by
  rcases hl with ⟨hlbst, hlbh, hlred⟩
  rcases hr with ⟨hrbst, hrbh, hrred⟩
  rcases hparent with ⟨hpbst, hpbh, hpred⟩
  simp only [is_bst] at hpbst
  simp only [satisfies_red_props] at hpred
  have hc := black_height_children c x l r hpbh
  unfold fixUp
  dsimp only
  split <;> split <;> split
  <;> simp only [rotateLeft, rotateRight, flipColors,
    leftChild, rightChild, is_red, rootSafe, is_llrbt,
    is_bst, satisfies_red_props, black_height,
    Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at *
  <;> grind

private theorem insertAux_valid (t : Node) (v : Int)
    (ht : is_llrbt t) (hs : rootSafe t) :
    is_llrbt (insertAux t v) ∧
    rootSafe (insertAux t v) ∧
    black_height (insertAux t v) = black_height t := by
  induction t with
  | Empty =>
      exact red_leaf_valid v
  | Tree c x l r ihl ihr =>
      have hl : is_llrbt l := left_valid c x l r ht
      have hr : is_llrbt r := right_valid c x l r ht
      have hls : rootSafe l :=
        left_rootSafe c x l r ht.2.2
      have hrs : rootSafe r :=
        right_rootSafe c x l r ht.2.2
      simp only [insertAux]
      split
      · rename_i hvx
        have hi := ihl hl hls
        have hord : ∀ z ∈ view l ∪ {v}, z < x := by
          intro z hz
          rcases hz with hz | hz
          · exact ht.1.1 z hz
          · simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hvx
        exact fixUp_left_valid c x v l r hord
          hi.1 hi.2.1 hi.2.2 hr hs ht
      · split
        · rename_i hnvx hxv
          have hi := ihr hr hrs
          have hord : ∀ z ∈ view r ∪ {v}, z > x := by
            intro z hz
            rcases hz with hz | hz
            · exact ht.1.2.2.1 z hz
            · simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hxv
          exact fixUp_right_valid c x v l r hord
            hl hi.1 hi.2.1 hi.2.2 hs ht
        · exact ⟨ht, hs, rfl⟩

-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem insert_postcond_satisfied (t : Node) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : insert_precond t) :
    insert_postcond t v (insert t v h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  have hb : is_llrbt (blacken t) :=
    blacken_valid t h_precond
  have hs : rootSafe (blacken t) :=
    blacken_rootSafe t
  have hi : is_llrbt (insertAux (blacken t) v) :=
    (insertAux_valid (blacken t) v hb hs).1
  constructor
  · exact blacken_valid (insertAux (blacken t) v) hi
  · rw [view_blacken, view_insertAux, view_blacken]
  -- !benchmark @end proof

-- Dafny spec says: "This allows the root to be Red or Black"
def is_llrbt (t : Node) : Prop :=
  is_bst t ∧
  black_height t ≠ -1 ∧
  -- We need to check red properties. Dafny's satisfies_red_props handles recursive checks.
  -- But wait, Dafny's `satisfies_red_props` seems to strictly forbid right-leaning reds everywhere?
  -- Let's re-read Dafny carefully.
  -- satisfy_red_props:
  --   left_ok && right_ok && right_is_black && no_double_red
  --   Right is black: if right is red -> false.
  --   No double red on left: if left is red, left.left cannot be red? No, `l.is_red` then `l.left` check?
  --   Dafny: `match this.left { case Some(l) => if l.is_red then match l.left { case Some(ll) => !ll.is_red ...`
  --   This means: If I am any node, my right child cannot be red. And if my left child is red, IT'S left child cannot be red (no consecutive reds on left edge).
  --   What about Me being Red and Left being Red? Dafny spec doesn't explicitly ban `this.is_red && this.left.is_red` in `satisfies_red_props` itself?
  --   Ah, `no_double_red` checks `this.left` (l) and `l.left` (ll).
  --   So it prevents `Red -> Red` on the left edge.
  satisfies_red_props t



-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def insert_precond (t : Node) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_llrbt t
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

def blacken : Node → Node
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree _ x l r => Node.Tree Color.Black x l r

def leftChild : Node → Node
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree _ _ l _ => l

def rightChild : Node → Node
  | Node.Empty => Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree _ _ _ r => r

def rotateLeft : Node → Node
  | Node.Tree c x a (Node.Tree Color.Red y b d) =>
      Node.Tree c y (Node.Tree Color.Red x a b) d
  | t => t

def rotateRight : Node → Node
  | Node.Tree c y (Node.Tree Color.Red x a b) d =>
      Node.Tree c x a (Node.Tree Color.Red y b d)
  | t => t

def flipColors : Node → Node
  | Node.Tree c x
      (Node.Tree Color.Red y a b)
      (Node.Tree Color.Red z d e) =>
      Node.Tree c x
        (Node.Tree Color.Black y a b)
        (Node.Tree Color.Black z d e)
  | t => t

def fixUp (t : Node) : Node :=
  let t₁ :=
    if is_red (rightChild t) && !is_red (leftChild t) then
      rotateLeft t
    else
      t
  let t₂ :=
    if is_red (leftChild t₁) &&
        is_red (leftChild (leftChild t₁)) then
      rotateRight t₁
    else
      t₁
  if is_red (leftChild t₂) && is_red (rightChild t₂) then
    flipColors t₂
  else
    t₂

def insertAux : Node → Int → Node
  | Node.Empty, v =>
      Node.Tree Color.Red v Node.Empty Node.Empty
  | Node.Tree c x l r, v =>
      if v < x then
        fixUp (Node.Tree c x (insertAux l v) r)
      else if x < v then
        fixUp (Node.Tree c x l (insertAux r v))
      else
        Node.Tree c x l r

def rootSafe : Node → Prop
  | Node.Empty => True
  | Node.Tree Color.Black _ _ _ => True
  | Node.Tree Color.Red _ l r =>
      is_red l = false ∧ is_red r = false

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def insert (t : Node) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : insert_precond t) : Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  blacken (insertAux (blacken t) v)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def insert_postcond (t : Node) (v : Int) (result : Node)
    (_ : insert_precond t) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_llrbt result ∧
  view result = view t ∪ {v}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

private theorem view_blacken (t : Node) :
    view (blacken t) = view t := by
  cases t <;> rfl

private theorem view_rotateLeft (t : Node) :
    view (rotateLeft t) = view t := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => rfl
  | Tree c x l r =>
      cases r with
      | Empty => rfl
      | Tree rc y rl rr =>
          cases rc
          · ext z
            simp only [rotateLeft, view, Set.mem_union,
              Set.mem_singleton_iff]
            aesop
          · rfl

private theorem view_rotateRight (t : Node) :
    view (rotateRight t) = view t := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => rfl
  | Tree c x l r =>
      cases l with
      | Empty => rfl
      | Tree lc y ll lr =>
          cases lc
          · ext z
            simp only [rotateRight, view, Set.mem_union,
              Set.mem_singleton_iff]
            aesop
          · rfl

private theorem view_flipColors (t : Node) :
    view (flipColors t) = view t := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => rfl
  | Tree c x l r =>
      cases l with
      | Empty => rfl
      | Tree lc y ll lr =>
          cases lc with
          | Black => rfl
          | Red =>
              cases r with
              | Empty => rfl
              | Tree rc z rl rr =>
                  cases rc <;> rfl

private theorem view_fixUp (t : Node) :
    view (fixUp t) = view t := by
  unfold fixUp
  dsimp only
  split
  · split
    · split
      · rw [view_flipColors, view_rotateRight, view_rotateLeft]
      · rw [view_rotateRight, view_rotateLeft]
    · split
      · rw [view_flipColors, view_rotateLeft]
      · rw [view_rotateLeft]
  · split
    · split
      · rw [view_flipColors, view_rotateRight]
      · rw [view_rotateRight]
    · split
      · rw [view_flipColors]
      · rfl

private theorem view_insertAux (t : Node) (v : Int) :
    view (insertAux t v) = view t ∪ {v} := by
  induction t with
  | Empty =>
      ext z
      simp [insertAux, view]
  | Tree c x l r ihl ihr =>
      simp only [insertAux]
      split
      · rw [view_fixUp]
        simp only [view, ihl]
        ext z
        simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
        aesop
      · split
        · rw [view_fixUp]
          simp only [view, ihr]
          ext z
          simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
          aesop
        · rename_i h₁ h₂
          have hvx : v = x := by omega
          subst v
          ext z
          simp only [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
          aesop

private theorem black_height_children
    (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node)
    (h : black_height (Node.Tree c x l r) ≠ -1) :
    black_height l ≠ -1 ∧
    black_height r ≠ -1 ∧
    black_height l = black_height r := by
  by_contra hn
  apply h
  simp only [black_height]
  rw [if_neg hn]

private theorem black_height_pos (t : Node)
    (h : black_height t ≠ -1) :
    0 < black_height t := by
  induction t with
  | Empty =>
      norm_num [black_height]
  | Tree c x l r ihl ihr =>
      have hc := black_height_children c x l r h
      simp only [black_height]
      rw [if_pos hc]
      have hp := ihl hc.1
      cases c with
      | Red =>
          have heq : (Color.Red == Color.Black) = false := by
            decide
          simp only [heq, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
          exact hp
      | Black =>
          have heq : (Color.Black == Color.Black) = true := by
            decide
          simp only [heq, if_true]
          omega

private theorem blacken_valid (t : Node)
    (h : is_llrbt t) :
    is_llrbt (blacken t) := by
  cases t with
  | Empty => exact h
  | Tree c x l r =>
      rcases h with ⟨hbst, hbh, hred⟩
      have hc := black_height_children c x l r hbh
      refine ⟨hbst, ?_, hred⟩
      simp only [blacken, black_height]
      rw [if_pos hc]
      have heq : (Color.Black == Color.Black) = true := by
        decide
      simp only [heq, if_true]
      have hp := black_height_pos l hc.1
      omega

private theorem blacken_rootSafe (t : Node) :
    rootSafe (blacken t) := by
  cases t <;> trivial

private theorem left_valid
    (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node)
    (h : is_llrbt (Node.Tree c x l r)) :
    is_llrbt l := by
  rcases h with ⟨hb, hh, hr⟩
  simp only [is_bst] at hb
  simp only [satisfies_red_props] at hr
  have hc := black_height_children c x l r hh
  exact ⟨hb.2.1, hc.1, hr.1⟩

private theorem right_valid
    (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node)
    (h : is_llrbt (Node.Tree c x l r)) :
    is_llrbt r := by
  rcases h with ⟨hb, hh, hr⟩
  simp only [is_bst] at hb
  simp only [satisfies_red_props] at hr
  have hc := black_height_children c x l r hh
  exact ⟨hb.2.2.2, hc.2.1, hr.2.1⟩

private theorem left_rootSafe
    (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node)
    (h : satisfies_red_props (Node.Tree c x l r)) :
    rootSafe l := by
  simp only [satisfies_red_props] at h
  rcases h with ⟨hl, hr, hright, hleft⟩
  cases l with
  | Empty => trivial
  | Tree lc y ll lr =>
      cases lc with
      | Black => trivial
      | Red =>
          simp only [rootSafe]
          constructor
          · cases ll with
            | Empty => rfl
            | Tree llc z a b =>
                cases llc with
                | Black => rfl
                | Red =>
                    exact False.elim hleft
          · simp only [satisfies_red_props] at hl
            have hnr := hl.2.2.1
            cases heq : is_red lr with
            | false => exact heq
            | true =>
                simp only [heq, if_true] at hnr

private theorem right_rootSafe
    (c : Color) (x : Int) (l r : Node)
    (h : satisfies_red_props (Node.Tree c x l r)) :
    rootSafe r := by
  simp only [satisfies_red_props] at h
  have hnr := h.2.2.1
  cases r with
  | Empty => trivial
  | Tree rc y rl rr =>
      cases rc with
      | Black => trivial
      | Red =>
          simp only [is_red, if_true] at hnr

private theorem red_leaf_valid (v : Int) :
    is_llrbt (Node.Tree Color.Red v Node.Empty Node.Empty) ∧
    rootSafe (Node.Tree Color.Red v Node.Empty Node.Empty) ∧
    black_height (Node.Tree Color.Red v Node.Empty Node.Empty) =
      black_height Node.Empty := by
  have heq : (Color.Red == Color.Black) = false := by
    decide
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [is_bst, view]
    · simp only [black_height, heq, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
      omega
    · simp [satisfies_red_props, is_red]
  · simp [rootSafe, is_red]
  · simp only [black_height, heq, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]

private theorem fixUp_left_valid
    (c : Color) (x v : Int) (l r : Node)
    (hord : ∀ z ∈ view l ∪ {v}, z < x)
    (hl : is_llrbt (insertAux l v))
    (hls : rootSafe (insertAux l v))
    (hlh : black_height (insertAux l v) = black_height l)
    (hr : is_llrbt r)
    (hroot : rootSafe (Node.Tree c x l r))
    (hparent : is_llrbt (Node.Tree c x l r)) :
    is_llrbt (fixUp (Node.Tree c x (insertAux l v) r)) ∧
    rootSafe (fixUp (Node.Tree c x (insertAux l v) r)) ∧
    black_height (fixUp (Node.Tree c x (insertAux l v) r)) =
      black_height (Node.Tree c x l r) := by
  rcases hl with ⟨hlbst, hlbh, hlred⟩
  rcases hr with ⟨hrbst, hrbh, hrred⟩
  rcases hparent with ⟨hpbst, hpbh, hpred⟩
  simp only [is_bst] at hpbst
  simp only [satisfies_red_props] at hpred
  have hc := black_height_children c x l r hpbh
  unfold fixUp
  dsimp only
  split <;> split <;> split
  <;> simp only [rotateLeft, rotateRight, flipColors,
    leftChild, rightChild, is_red, rootSafe, is_llrbt,
    is_bst, satisfies_red_props, black_height,
    Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at *
  <;> grind

private theorem fixUp_right_valid
    (c : Color) (x v : Int) (l r : Node)
    (hord : ∀ z ∈ view r ∪ {v}, z > x)
    (hl : is_llrbt l)
    (hr : is_llrbt (insertAux r v))
    (hrs : rootSafe (insertAux r v))
    (hrh : black_height (insertAux r v) = black_height r)
    (hroot : rootSafe (Node.Tree c x l r))
    (hparent : is_llrbt (Node.Tree c x l r)) :
    is_llrbt (fixUp (Node.Tree c x l (insertAux r v))) ∧
    rootSafe (fixUp (Node.Tree c x l (insertAux r v))) ∧
    black_height (fixUp (Node.Tree c x l (insertAux r v))) =
      black_height (Node.Tree c x l r) := by
  rcases hl with ⟨hlbst, hlbh, hlred⟩
  rcases hr with ⟨hrbst, hrbh, hrred⟩
  rcases hparent with ⟨hpbst, hpbh, hpred⟩
  simp only [is_bst] at hpbst
  simp only [satisfies_red_props] at hpred
  have hc := black_height_children c x l r hpbh
  unfold fixUp
  dsimp only
  split <;> split <;> split
  <;> simp only [rotateLeft, rotateRight, flipColors,
    leftChild, rightChild, is_red, rootSafe, is_llrbt,
    is_bst, satisfies_red_props, black_height,
    Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at *
  <;> grind

private theorem insertAux_valid (t : Node) (v : Int)
    (ht : is_llrbt t) (hs : rootSafe t) :
    is_llrbt (insertAux t v) ∧
    rootSafe (insertAux t v) ∧
    black_height (insertAux t v) = black_height t := by
  induction t with
  | Empty =>
      exact red_leaf_valid v
  | Tree c x l r ihl ihr =>
      have hl : is_llrbt l := left_valid c x l r ht
      have hr : is_llrbt r := right_valid c x l r ht
      have hls : rootSafe l :=
        left_rootSafe c x l r ht.2.2
      have hrs : rootSafe r :=
        right_rootSafe c x l r ht.2.2
      simp only [insertAux]
      split
      · rename_i hvx
        have hi := ihl hl hls
        have hord : ∀ z ∈ view l ∪ {v}, z < x := by
          intro z hz
          rcases hz with hz | hz
          · exact ht.1.1 z hz
          · simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hvx
        exact fixUp_left_valid c x v l r hord
          hi.1 hi.2.1 hi.2.2 hr hs ht
      · split
        · rename_i hnvx hxv
          have hi := ihr hr hrs
          have hord : ∀ z ∈ view r ∪ {v}, z > x := by
            intro z hz
            rcases hz with hz | hz
            · exact ht.1.2.2.1 z hz
            · simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hxv
          exact fixUp_right_valid c x v l r hord
            hl hi.1 hi.2.1 hi.2.2 hs ht
        · exact ⟨ht, hs, rfl⟩

-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem insert_postcond_satisfied (t : Node) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : insert_precond t) :
    insert_postcond t v (insert t v h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  have hb : is_llrbt (blacken t) :=
    blacken_valid t h_precond
  have hs : rootSafe (blacken t) :=
    blacken_rootSafe t
  have hi : is_llrbt (insertAux (blacken t) v) :=
    (insertAux_valid (blacken t) v hb hs).1
  constructor
  · exact blacken_valid (insertAux (blacken t) v) hi
  · rw [view_blacken, view_insertAux, view_blacken]
  -- !benchmark @end proof
